benchmark: The NZ benchmark places do not apply to the Top End. Rules applied instead (COVERAGE.md): Australia destination bar of at least four kept spots or flagship rank (Darwin 20, Litchfield 8; Tiwi, Mary River and Adelaide River each stand alone with fewer than four neighbours); name test with name_evidence (Wikivoyage Darwin and Litchfield pages); a national park that clears the bar is a destination, a thin one is standalone and never a spot of another park (Mary River, Charles Darwin NP stays a Darwin stop as a small park, not a spot of a park); a long or remote feature is placed where visitors reach it (Tabletop Track, Lost City under Litchfield, Fogg Dam and Berry Springs as Darwin day trips); a town is a spot only when it is a draw and never beside its attraction (Humpty Doo folded into the Big Boxing Crocodile); a vehicle/operator not a spot (cruises not kept); events, venues of screenings and tide/once-weekly things rejected (festivals, Beer Can Regatta, Deckchair Cinema review); negative benchmarks of the same kind (Government House, Darwin Entertainment Centre, Brown's Mart, Lyons Cottage) rejected. All 143 candidates were scored by views and counted sources; every candidate with views above the lowest kept (0) and not kept is listed in stronger_left_out with a reason (27, all rejected on a concrete What-qualifies ground or sent to review). No kept place was dropped except the Humpty Doo fold, flagged for the owner.
